item: Living sources ride the encrypted backup: the Wikipedia store is exported and merged back additively (R729)
summary: The backup dialog's Living sources row was disabled because no lane format existed. A lane now rides the oo-volumes-2 set as a lanes/<kind>.db member, snapshotted with sqlcipher_export at SQLCipher's compiled-in page size with its own encryption kept (an ATTACH ... KEY reads a keyed file only at that size; the live file keeps DB-10's 16384), and the manifest lists it under lane_members (absent from a lane-less set, so its manifest is unchanged). On import, after the corpus merge, each member is ATTACHed with its key (corpus passphrase, live key, backup passphrase) to the live lane and merged in ONE transaction on natural keys: entities by external_id (new ones inserted with their flags, local flags kept, NULL identity columns filled), revisions by (entity, revision_ref) and changes by (feed, change_ref) inserted only, a differing baseline kept as a revision, facts and walk pages by later reading (equal keeps local), WARM pages pooled to the two newest texts (Q710). Cursors, gaps, size samples, disclosures and this machine's hourly/edition stats stay behind; the lane's search index requeues itself through its triggers. No plaintext lane file is written. Re-importing the same backup changes nothing (tested), a failure rolls the lane back (tested). Only lanes this build can merge are exported (wiki now; law and osm in later PRs). Old builds stage the member, check its hash and ignore it.
